Three figures of the SAME person as the reference, in the SAME clothes, side by side on one sheet with wide gaps of background between them so they do not touch, all at exactly the same scale. LEFT: sitting on a low sofa that is NOT drawn, seen from the front, the knees forward, the hands in the lap, the head tipped back, eyes half shut. The person: a heavy woman of about sixty with wavy grey hair, a cream blouse under a white smock with old brown stains, a white apron, thick flesh-coloured stockings, worn brown slip-on shoes. Something about this person is subtly off. No smile, not cheerful, not clean or cartoonish.
